Running command: python3 -c "
# Continue parsing the sequence header
data = open('/tmp/seeds/testdata/soccer_cif_20f_q16_bd10.ivf','rb').read()
frame_data = data[44:]
seq_payload = frame_data[4:4+11]
bits = ''.join(f'{b:08b}' for b in seq_payload)
pos = 55  # where we left off

# frame_id_numbers_present_flag (1 bit)  
frame_id_present = int(bits[pos], 2)
pos += 1
print(f'frame_id_numbers_present_flag: {frame_id_present}')

# use_128x128_superblock (1 bit)
use_128 = int(bits[pos], 2)
pos += 1
print(f'use_128x128_superblock: {use_128}')

# enable_filter_intra (1 bit)
filter_intra = int(bits[pos], 2)
pos += 1
print(f'enable_filter_intra: {filter_intra}')

# enable_intra_edge_filter (1 bit)
intra_edge = int(bits[pos], 2)
pos += 1
print(f'enable_intra_edge_filter: {intra_edge}')

# enable_interintra_compound (1 bit)
interintra = int(bits[pos], 2)
pos += 1
print(f'enable_interintra_compound: {interintra}')

# enable_masked_compound (1 bit)
masked = int(bits[pos], 2)
pos += 1
print(f'enable_masked_compound: {masked}')

# enable_warped_motion (1 bit)
warped = int(bits[pos], 2)
pos += 1
print(f'enable_warped_motion: {warped}')

# enable_dual_filter (1 bit)
dual_filter = int(bits[pos], 2)
pos += 1
print(f'enable_dual_filter: {dual_filter}')

# enable_order_hint (1 bit)
order_hint = int(bits[pos], 2)
pos += 1
print(f'enable_order_hint: {order_hint}')

if order_hint:
    # enable_jnt_comp (1 bit)
    jnt_comp = int(bits[pos], 2)
    pos += 1
    print(f'  enable_jnt_comp: {jnt_comp}')
    # enable_ref_frame_mvs (1 bit)
    ref_frame_mvs = int(bits[pos], 2)
    pos += 1
    print(f'  enable_ref_frame_mvs: {ref_frame_mvs}')

# seq_choose_screen_content_tools (1 bit)
choose_sct = int(bits[pos], 2)
pos += 1
print(f'seq_choose_screen_content_tools: {choose_sct}')

if not choose_sct:
    seq_force_sct = int(bits[pos], 2)
    pos += 1
    print(f'  seq_force_screen_content_tools: {seq_force_sct}')

# more parsing needed for color config...
print(f'Position after feature flags: {pos}')
print(f'Remaining: {bits[pos:pos+32]}')
"
